title: Design System: SQL Compiler Query Workbench

title.purpose: Main interface heading; no separate display face.

body.purpose: Common explanatory copy; smaller annotations are contextual metadata.

editor.purpose: Whitespace-preserving source entry with aligned line numbers.

plan.purpose: Before/after relational plans with generous line spacing.

plan-mobile.purpose: Stacked plans; scroll rather than shrinking further.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Color-only button feedback; no movement or lift.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to all elements and pseudo-elements under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.css: .ds-result{background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--rule,#d8e1e7);border-radius:5px;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;color:var(--text,#1d303e);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-result-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#d8e1e7);padding:14px 17px}.ds-result-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:650}.ds-result-heading>span{font-size:.6875rem;color:var(--muted,#556774)}.ds-table-scroll{min-width:0;overflow:auto;outline-offset:4px}.ds-table-scroll:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #007c92}.ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.75rem;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}.ds-table th{font-size:.625rem;color:var(--muted,#556774);background:#f7f9fb;font-weight:550}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{padding:10px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7edf1}.ds-table td{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-table tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:#f8fbfc}

components.name: Compiler stage control
components.description: Selected stage with ordinal, explicit completion status, and recorded timing.

components.css: .ds-plan-pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#d8e1e7);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#1d303e)}.ds-plan-pane{min-width:0}.ds-plan-pane+.ds-plan-pane{border-left:1px solid var(--rule,#d8e1e7)}.ds-plan-pane h3{margin:0;padding:16px 19px 10px;font:600 .75rem system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-plan-code{margin:0;min-height:180px;padding:8px 19px 22px;font:.8125rem/1.95 var(--code,"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace);overflow:auto;tab-size:2;outline-offset:4px}.ds-plan-code>span{display:block;white-space:pre;height:1.95em}.ds-plan-code .ds-plan-moved{color:#005f6e;background:#edf7f7}.ds-plan-code:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #007c92}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-plan-pair{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.ds-plan-pane+.ds-plan-pane{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#d8e1e7)}.ds-plan-code{min-height:auto}}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-plan-pane h3{padding-inline:13px}.ds-plan-code{padding-inline:13px;font-size:.75rem}}

narrative.overview:
A familiar Kibana-style workbench: navy navigation, white working surfaces, cool-gray dividers, and teal actions. The light workspace supports a projector-friendly compiler walkthrough. Density serves inspection rather than dashboard decoration.

This records the implemented console, not a new identity proposal. The confirmed workbench direction overrides seed `8c05e545`; system sans and code-focused monospace are intentional brief-pinned choices.
keyCharacteristics: Light, bordered working surfaces against navy navigation.
Compact interface text with spacious, scrollable compiler artifacts.
Explicit selection, execution status, and evidence provenance.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with labels or symbols; retain the selected-stage underline and keyboard focus outline.

rules.name: The Plan Readability Rule
rules.body: Keep plans at the `plan` role on desktop (13px) and `plan-mobile` role at the mobile breakpoint (12px), with preserved whitespace and horizontal scrolling. Do not shrink code to force it into a pane.

dos: Do preserve the light workbench, navy navigation, and restrained teal action hierarchy.
Do retain readable, scrollable plans and the labeled before/after comparison.
Do expose focus, status labels, and the provenance of displayed evidence.
Do distinguish the selected storage backend and actual runtime engine availability.
donts: Don't turn this compiler inspector into a marketing page or an unsupported metrics dashboard.
Don't use monospace for interface headings or shrink code to avoid overflow.
Don't hide stale, failed, skipped, or unavailable states behind success styling.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients, or display typography absent from this implemented world.
